questions.stem: A 24-year-old woman with no prior refractive error undergoes LASIK surgery. Her identical twin, who underwent phakic intraocular lens implantation instead, has identical axial length and lens characteristics. Scenario A: LASIK was performed reducing the anterior corneal curvature. Scenario B: A high refractive index phakic IOL was implanted anterior to the natural lens. Which of the following correctly compares the optical outcomes between Scenario A and Scenario B?

options.label: A
options.text: Myopic shift occurs in Scenario A; emmetropia maintained in Scenario B

options.label: B
options.text: Hyperopic shift occurs in Scenario A; increased effective lens power in Scenario B

options.label: C
options.text: No change in total refractive power in either scenario

options.label: D
options.text: Scenario A increases anterior chamber depth; Scenario B reduces axial length
